_why: PROG-02. The sequence is the same every morning and one step of it is conditional - stock the shelf only when the shelf is empty. Before control flow the only way to file this was a fixed list that stocked whether or not it needed to, so the resident kept the sequence in its head and paid a decision per step. This is the situation the feature was built for; if a model does not reach for it here it will not reach for it anywhere.
open_question_to_me: For four mornings you have done the same thing: looked at the mill's shelf, and if it was empty put your flour on it and posted a price. On two of those mornings the shelf still had flour and you stocked it anyway.
